name: gallery
summary: Review the public gallery (SPEC-SHARING-GALLERY): list reported or hidden patches with their reasons, then hide one, keep it (clear its reports) or remove it from the gallery. Manage the site's own @blokdust account (R16): publish the built-in presets as its EXAMPLES, hand it the sign-ins of an account made for it, and move its patches between EXAMPLES and TUTORIALS. Works on a deployed env's D1 or a local test state.
usage: pnpm bd gallery kind <id> tutorial --env staging
outputs: JSON on stdout: the reported patches, or what was done
